<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="author" content="404">
    <title>404</title>
    <link rel='stylesheet prefetch' href='/restaurant/assets/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css'>
    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <meta name="author" content="404">
    <title>404</title>
    <link rel='stylesheet prefetch' href='/restaurant/assets/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css'>
    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <meta name="author" content="404">
    <title>404</title>
    <link rel='stylesheet prefetch' href='/restaurant/assets/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css'>
    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;

        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;

            line-height: 30px;

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;

        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <meta charset="UTF-8">

    <link rel='stylesheet prefetch' href='/restaurant/assets/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css'>
    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <style type="text/css">
        body {
            background: #f3f3f4;
            color: #676a6c;
            font-family: "Roboto", sans-serif;
        }
        body h1 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        body p {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 30px;
        }
        body a {
            color: #F7A468;
        }

        svg {
            display: block;
            margin: 35px auto;
            overflow: visible !important;
        }
        svg #robot_1_ {
            animation-name: verticalAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
        }
        svg #light_1_ {
            animation-name: blinkLight;
            animation-duration: 0.5s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: steps(2);
        }
        svg #shadow_1_ {
            animation-name: shadowAnimation;
            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>

            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

            animation-duration: 1s;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-direction: alternate;
            animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
            transform-origin: 50%;
        }

        @keyframes wave {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(120deg);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(170deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveLeftArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes moveRightArm {
            0% {
                transform: rotate(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-4deg);
            }
        }
        @keyframes shadowAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
                opacity: 0.6;
            }
        }
        @keyframes verticalAnimation {
            0% {
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkLight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes blinkEye {
            0% {
                transform: scaleY(0);
            }
            4% {
                transform: scaleY(1);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
